{{Short description|none}} {{Shintoism}} <!-- Inari shrines are to be included in this list - no need to make a separate page for them. --> This is a '''list of notable [[Shinto shrine]]s''' in [[Japan]]. There are tens of thousands of shrines in [[Japan]]. Shrines with structures that are [[National Treasures of Japan]] are covered by the [[List of National Treasures of Japan (shrines)]]. For Shinto shrines in other countries, scroll down to the [[#See also|See also]] section.
Shinto shrines from specific sects or new churches are not included in this list.

There are tens of thousands of shrines in [[Japan]]. Shrines with structures that are [[National Treasures of Japan]] are covered by the [[List of National Treasures of Japan (shrines)]]. For Shinto shrines in other countries, scroll down to the [[#See also|See also]] section.
Shinto shrines from specific sects or new churches are not included in this list.

There are tens of thousands of shrines in [[Japan]]. Shrines with structures that are [[National Treasures of Japan]] are covered by the [[List of National Treasures of Japan (shrines)]]. For Shinto shrines in other countries, scroll down to the [[#See also|See also]] section.
Shinto shrines from specific sects or new churches are not included in this list.

This list includes all [[Beppyo shrine|Beppyo shrines]] and provincial [[Sōja shrine|Sōja Shrines]] and [[Ichinomiya]] Shinto shrines from specific sects or new churches are not included in this list. <!--interwikis from wikidata-->[[en:List of Shinto shrines in Japan]][[es:Anexo:Santuarios sintoístas]][[fr:Liste de sanctuaires shinto japonais]][[it:Lista di santuari shintoisti]][[ja:神社一覧]][[mr:जपानमधील शिंतो तीर्थस्थानांची यादी]][[simple:List of Shinto shrines]][[uk:Список синтоїстських святилищ]][[zh:日本神社列表]] {{afc comment|Wikidata entry [[d:Q2517815]] Wikidata name: list of Shinto shrines [[User:Immanuelle|Immanuelle]] ([[User talk:Immanuelle|talk]]) 07:56, 11 June 2025 (UTC)}} {{Short description|none}} {{Shintoism}}
This is a '''list of notable [[:en:Shinto shrine|Shinto shrine]]s''' in [[:en:Japan|Japan]]. There are tens of thousands of shrines in [[:en:Japan|Japan]]. Shrines with structures that are [[:en:National Treasure (Japan)|National Treasure (Japan)]] are covered by the [[:en:List of National Treasures of Japan (shrines)|List of National Treasures of Japan (shrines)]]. For Shinto shrines in other countries, scroll down to the [[#See also|See also]] section.
This list includes all [[Beppyo Shrine]]s and provincial [[Sōja shrine|Sōja Shrines]] and [[Ichinomiya]]
Shinto shrines from specific sects or new churches are not included in this list.
{{TOC right}}

This is a '''list of notable [[:en:Shinto shrine|Shinto shrine]]s''' in [[:en:Japan|Japan]]. There are tens of thousands of shrines in [[:en:Japan|Japan]]. Shrines with structures that are [[:en:National Treasure (Japan)|National Treasure (Japan)]] are covered by the [[:en:List of National Treasures of Japan (shrines)|List of National Treasures of Japan (shrines)]]. For Shinto shrines in other countries, scroll down to the [[#See also|See also]] section.
This list includes all [[Beppyo Shrine]]s and provincial [[Sōja shrine|Sōja Shrines]] and [[Ichinomiya]]
Shinto shrines from specific sects or new churches are not included in this list.

This is a '''list of notable [[:en:Shinto shrine|Shinto shrine]]s''' in [[:en:Japan|Japan]]. There are tens of thousands of shrines in [[:en:Japan|Japan]]. Shrines with structures that are [[:en:National Treasure (Japan)|National Treasure (Japan)]] are covered by the [[:en:List of National Treasures of Japan (shrines)|List of National Treasures of Japan (shrines)]]. For Shinto shrines in other countries, scroll down to the [[#See also|See also]] section.
This list includes all [[Beppyo Shrine]]s and provincial [[Sōja shrine|Sōja Shrines]] and [[Ichinomiya]]
Shinto shrines from specific sects or new churches are not included in this list.

This is a '''list of notable [[:en:Shinto shrine|Shinto shrine]]s''' in [[:en:Japan|Japan]]. There are tens of thousands of shrines in [[:en:Japan|Japan]]. Shrines with structures that are [[:en:National Treasure (Japan)|National Treasure (Japan)]] are covered by the [[:en:List of National Treasures of Japan (shrines)|List of National Treasures of Japan (shrines)]]. For Shinto shrines in other countries, scroll down to the [[#See also|See also]] section.
This list includes all [[Beppyo Shrine]]s and provincial [[Sōja shrine|Sōja Shrines]] and [[Ichinomiya]]
Shinto shrines from specific sects or new churches are not included in this list.

This is a '''list of notable [[:en:Shinto shrine|Shinto shrine]]s''' in [[:en:Japan|Japan]]. There are tens of thousands of shrines in [[:en:Japan|Japan]]. Shrines with structures that are [[:en:National Treasure (Japan)|National Treasure (Japan)]] are covered by the [[:en:List of National Treasures of Japan (shrines)|List of National Treasures of Japan (shrines)]]. For Shinto shrines in other countries, scroll down to the [[#See also|See also]] section.
This list includes all [[Beppyo Shrine]]s and provincial [[Sōja shrine|Sōja Shrines]] and [[Ichinomiya]]
Shinto shrines from specific sects or new churches are not included in this list.

This is a '''list of notable [[:en:Shinto shrine|Shinto shrine]]s''' in [[:en:Japan|Japan]]. There are tens of thousands of shrines in [[:en:Japan|Japan]]. Shrines with structures that are [[:en:National Treasure (Japan)|National Treasure (Japan)]] are covered by the [[:en:List of National Treasures of Japan (shrines)|List of National Treasures of Japan (shrines)]]. For Shinto shrines in other countries, scroll down to the [[#See also|See also]] section.

This list includes all [[Beppyo Shrine]]s and provincial [[Sōja shrine|Sōja Shrines]] and [[Ichinomiya]]

Shinto shrines from specific sects or new churches are not included in this list.

This is a '''list of notable [[:en:Shinto shrine|Shinto shrine]]s''' in [[:en:Japan|Japan]]. There are tens of thousands of shrines in [[:en:Japan|Japan]]. Shrines with structures that are [[:en:National Treasure (Japan)|National Treasure (Japan)]] are covered by the [[:en:List of National Treasures of Japan (shrines)|List of National Treasures of Japan (shrines)]]. For Shinto shrines in other countries, scroll down to the [[#See also|See also]] section.

This list includes all [[Beppyo Shrine]]s and provincial [[Sōja shrine|Sōja Shrines]] and [[Ichinomiya]]

Shinto shrines from specific sects or new churches are not included in this list.

{{Shintoism}}

This is a '''list of notable [[:en:Shinto shrine|Shinto shrine]]s''' in [[:en:Japan|Japan]]. There are tens of thousands of shrines in [[:en:Japan|Japan]]. Shrines with structures that are [[:en:National Treasure (Japan)|National Treasure (Japan)]] are covered by the [[:en:List of National Treasures of Japan (shrines)|List of National Treasures of Japan (shrines)]]. For Shinto shrines in other countries, scroll down to the [[#See also|See also]] section.

This list includes all [[Beppyo Shrine]]s and provincial [[Sōja shrine|Sōja Shrines]] and [[Ichinomiya]]

Shinto shrines from specific sects or new churches are not included in this list.

This is a '''list of notable [[:en:Shinto shrine|Shinto shrine]]s''' in [[:en:Japan|Japan]]. There are tens of thousands of shrines in [[:en:Japan|Japan]]. Shrines with structures that are [[:en:National Treasure (Japan)|National Treasure (Japan)]] are covered by the [[:en:List of National Treasures of Japan (shrines)|List of National Treasures of Japan (shrines)]]. For Shinto shrines in other countries, scroll down to the [[#See also|See also]] section.

This list includes all [[Beppyo Shrine]]s and provincial [[Sōja shrine|Sōja Shrines]] and [[Ichinomiya]]

Shinto shrines from specific sects or new churches are not included in this list.

This is a '''list of notable [[:en:Shinto shrine|Shinto shrine]]s''' in [[:en:Japan|Japan]]. There are tens of thousands of shrines in [[:en:Japan|Japan]]. Shrines with structures that are [[:en:National Treasure (Japan)|National Treasure (Japan)]] are covered by the [[:en:List of National Treasures of Japan (shrines)|List of National Treasures of Japan (shrines)]]. For Shinto shrines in other countries, scroll down to the [[#See also|See also]] section.

This list includes all [[Beppyo Shrine]]s and provincial [[Sōja shrine|Sōja Shrines]] and [[Ichinomiya]]

Shinto shrines from specific sects or new churches are not included in this list.

This is a '''list of notable [[:en:Shinto shrine|Shinto shrine]]s''' in [[:en:Japan|Japan]]. There are tens of thousands of shrines in [[:en:Japan|Japan]]. Shrines with structures that are [[:en:National Treasure (Japan)|National Treasure (Japan)]] are covered by the [[:en:List of National Treasures of Japan (shrines)|List of National Treasures of Japan (shrines)]]. For Shinto shrines in other countries, scroll down to the [[#See also|See also]] section.

This list includes all [[Beppyo Shrine]]s and provincial [[Sōja shrine|Sōja Shrines]] and [[Ichinomiya]]

Shinto shrines from specific sects or new churches are not included in this list.

This is a '''list of notable [[:en:Shinto shrine|Shinto shrine]]s''' in [[:en:Japan|Japan]]. There are tens of thousands of shrines in [[:en:Japan|Japan]]. Shrines with structures that are [[:en:National Treasure (Japan)|National Treasure (Japan)]] are covered by the [[:en:List of National Treasures of Japan (shrines)|List of National Treasures of Japan (shrines)]]. For Shinto shrines in other countries, scroll down to the [[#See also|See also]] section.

This list includes all [[Beppyo Shrine]]s and provincial [[Sōja shrine|Sōja Shrines]] and [[Ichinomiya]]

{{Shintoism}}

This is a '''list of notable [[:en:Shinto shrine|Shinto shrine]]s''' in [[:en:Japan|Japan]]. There are tens of thousands of shrines in [[:en:Japan|Japan]]. Shrines with structures that are [[:en:National Treasure (Japan)|National Treasure (Japan)]] are covered by the [[:en:List of National Treasures of Japan (shrines)|List of National Treasures of Japan (shrines)]]. For Shinto shrines in other countries, scroll down to the [[#See also|See also]] section.

This list includes all [[Beppyo Shrine]]s and provincial [[Sōja shrine|Sōja Shrines]] and [[Ichinomiya]]

Shinto shrines from specific sects or new churches are not included in this list.

This is a '''list of notable [[:en:Shinto shrine|Shinto shrine]]s''' in [[:en:Japan|Japan]]. There are tens of thousands of shrines in [[:en:Japan|Japan]]. Shrines with structures that are [[:en:National Treasure (Japan)|National Treasure (Japan)]] are covered by the [[:en:List of National Treasures of Japan (shrines)|List of National Treasures of Japan (shrines)]]. For Shinto shrines in other countries, scroll down to the [[#See also|See also]] section.

This list includes all [[Beppyo Shrine]]s and provincial [[Sōja shrine|Sōja Shrines]] and [[Ichinomiya]]

Shinto shrines from specific sects or new churches are not included in this list.

This is a '''list of notable [[:en:Shinto shrine|Shinto shrine]]s''' in [[:en:Japan|Japan]]. There are tens of thousands of shrines in [[:en:Japan|Japan]]. Shrines with structures that are [[:en:National Treasure (Japan)|National Treasure (Japan)]] are covered by the [[:en:List of National Treasures of Japan (shrines)|List of National Treasures of Japan (shrines)]]. For Shinto shrines in other countries, scroll down to the [[#See also|See also]] section.
This list includes all [[Beppyo Shrine]]s and provincial [[Sōja shrine|Sōja Shrines]] and [[Ichinomiya]]
Shinto shrines from specific sects or new churches are not included in this list.

This is a '''list of notable [[:en:Shinto shrine|Shinto shrine]]s''' in [[:en:Japan|Japan]]. There are tens of thousands of shrines in [[:en:Japan|Japan]]. Shrines with structures that are [[:en:National Treasure (Japan)|National Treasure (Japan)]] are covered by the [[:en:List of National Treasures of Japan (shrines)|List of National Treasures of Japan (shrines)]]. For Shinto shrines in other countries, scroll down to the [[#See also|See also]] section.
This list includes all [[Beppyo Shrine]]s and provincial [[Sōja shrine|Sōja Shrines]] and [[Ichinomiya]]
Shinto shrines from specific sects or new churches are not included in this list.

This is a '''list of notable [[:en:Shinto shrine|Shinto shrine]]s''' in [[:en:Japan|Japan]]. There are tens of thousands of shrines in [[:en:Japan|Japan]]. Shrines with structures that are [[:en:National Treasure (Japan)|National Treasure (Japan)]] are covered by the [[:en:List of National Treasures of Japan (shrines)|List of National Treasures of Japan (shrines)]]. For Shinto shrines in other countries, scroll down to the [[#See also|See also]] section.
This list includes all [[Beppyo Shrine]]s and provincial [[Sōja shrine|Sōja Shrines]] and [[Ichinomiya]]
Shinto shrines from specific sects or new churches are not included in this list.

This is a '''list of notable [[:en:Shinto shrine|Shinto shrine]]s''' in [[:en:Japan|Japan]]. There are tens of thousands of shrines in [[:en:Japan|Japan]]. Shrines with structures that are [[:en:National Treasure (Japan)|National Treasure (Japan)]] are covered by the [[:en:List of National Treasures of Japan (shrines)|List of National Treasures of Japan (shrines)]]. For Shinto shrines in other countries, scroll down to the [[#See also|See also]] section.
This list includes all [[Beppyo Shrine]]s and provincial [[Sōja shrine|Sōja Shrines]] and [[Ichinomiya]]
Shinto shrines from specific sects or new churches are not included in this list.

This is a '''list of notable [[:en:Shinto shrine|Shinto shrine]]s''' in [[:en:Japan|Japan]]. There are tens of thousands of shrines in [[:en:Japan|Japan]]. Shrines with structures that are [[:en:National Treasure (Japan)|National Treasure (Japan)]] are covered by the [[:en:List of National Treasures of Japan (shrines)|List of National Treasures of Japan (shrines)]]. For Shinto shrines in other countries, scroll down to the [[#See also|See also]] section.
This list includes all [[Beppyo Shrine]]s and provincial [[Sōja shrine|Sōja Shrines]] and [[Ichinomiya]]
Shinto shrines from specific sects or new churches are not included in this list.

This is a '''list of notable [[:en:Shinto shrine|Shinto shrine]]s''' in [[:en:Japan|Japan]]. There are tens of thousands of shrines in [[:en:Japan|Japan]]. Shrines with structures that are [[:en:National Treasure (Japan)|National Treasure (Japan)]] are covered by the [[:en:List of National Treasures of Japan (shrines)|List of National Treasures of Japan (shrines)]]. For Shinto shrines in other countries, scroll down to the [[#See also|See also]] section.
This list includes all [[Beppyo Shrine]]s and provincial [[Sōja shrine|Sōja Shrines]] and [[Ichinomiya]]
Shinto shrines from specific sects or new churches are not included in this list.

This is a '''list of notable [[:en:Shinto shrine|Shinto shrine]]s''' in [[:en:Japan|Japan]]. There are tens of thousands of shrines in [[:en:Japan|Japan]]. Shrines with structures that are [[:en:National Treasure (Japan)|National Treasure (Japan)]] are covered by the [[:en:List of National Treasures of Japan (shrines)|List of National Treasures of Japan (shrines)]]. For Shinto shrines in other countries, scroll down to the [[#See also|See also]] section.
This list includes all [[Beppyo Shrine]]s and provincial [[Sōja shrine|Sōja Shrines]] and [[Ichinomiya]]
Shinto shrines from specific sects or new churches are not included in this list.

This is a '''list of notable [[:en:Shinto shrine|Shinto shrine]]s''' in [[:en:Japan|Japan]]. There are tens of thousands of shrines in [[:en:Japan|Japan]]. Shrines with structures that are [[:en:National Treasure (Japan)|National Treasure (Japan)]] are covered by the [[:en:List of National Treasures of Japan (shrines)|List of National Treasures of Japan (shrines)]]. For Shinto shrines in other countries, scroll down to the [[#See also|See also]] section.
This list includes all [[Beppyo Shrine]]s and provincial [[Sōja shrine|Sōja Shrines]] and [[Ichinomiya]]
Shinto shrines from specific sects or new churches are not included in this list.

{{Shintoism}}

This is a '''list of notable {{ill|Shinto shrine|en|Shinto shrine|WD=Q845945|lt=Shinto shrine}}s''' in {{ill|Japan|en|Japan|WD=Q17|lt=Japan}}. There are tens of thousands of shrines in {{ill|Japan|en|Japan|WD=Q17|lt=Japan}}. Shrines with structures that are {{ill|National Treasure (Japan)|en|National Treasure (Japan)|WD=Q1139795|lt=National Treasure (Japan)}} are covered by the {{ill|List of National Treasures of Japan (shrines)|en|List of National Treasures of Japan (shrines)|WD=Q3245520|lt=List of National Treasures of Japan (shrines)}}. For Shinto shrines in other countries, scroll down to the [[#See also|See also]] section.

This list includes all [[Beppyo Shrine]]s and provincial [[Sōja shrine|Sōja Shrines]] and [[Ichinomiya]]

Shinto shrines from specific sects or new churches are not included in this list.

This is a '''list of notable {{ill|Shinto shrine|en|Shinto shrine|WD=Q845945|lt=Shinto shrine}}s''' in {{ill|Japan|en|Japan|WD=Q17|lt=Japan}}. There are tens of thousands of shrines in {{ill|Japan|en|Japan|WD=Q17|lt=Japan}}. Shrines with structures that are {{ill|National Treasure (Japan)|en|National Treasure (Japan)|WD=Q1139795|lt=National Treasure (Japan)}} are covered by the {{ill|List of National Treasures of Japan (shrines)|en|List of National Treasures of Japan (shrines)|WD=Q3245520|lt=List of National Treasures of Japan (shrines)}}. For Shinto shrines in other countries, scroll down to the [[#See also|See also]] section.

This list includes all [[Beppyo Shrine]]s and provincial [[Sōja shrine|Sōja Shrines]] and [[Ichinomiya]]

Shinto shrines from specific sects or new churches are not included in this list.

This is a '''list of notable {{ill|Shinto shrine|en|Shinto shrine|WD=Q845945|lt=Shinto shrine}}s''' in {{ill|Japan|en|Japan|WD=Q17|lt=Japan}}. There are tens of thousands of shrines in {{ill|Japan|en|Japan|WD=Q17|lt=Japan}}. Shrines with structures that are {{ill|National Treasure (Japan)|en|National Treasure (Japan)|WD=Q1139795|lt=National Treasure (Japan)}} are covered by the {{ill|List of National Treasures of Japan (shrines)|en|List of National Treasures of Japan (shrines)|WD=Q3245520|lt=List of National Treasures of Japan (shrines)}}. For Shinto shrines in other countries, scroll down to the [[#See also|See also]] section.

This list includes all [[Beppyo Shrine]]s and provincial [[Sōja shrine|Sōja Shrines]] and [[Ichinomiya]]

Shinto shrines from specific sects or new churches are not included in this list.

{{Shintoism}}

This is a '''list of notable {{ill|Shinto shrine|en|Shinto shrine|WD=Q845945|lt=Shinto shrine}}s''' in {{ill|Japan|en|Japan|WD=Q17|lt=Japan}}. There are tens of thousands of shrines in {{ill|Japan|en|Japan|WD=Q17|lt=Japan}}. Shrines with structures that are {{ill|National Treasure (Japan)|en|National Treasure (Japan)|WD=Q1139795|lt=National Treasure (Japan)}} are covered by the {{ill|List of National Treasures of Japan (shrines)|en|List of National Treasures of Japan (shrines)|WD=Q3245520|lt=List of National Treasures of Japan (shrines)}}. For Shinto shrines in other countries, scroll down to the [[#See also|See also]] section.

This list includes all [[Beppyo Shrine]]s and provincial [[Sōja shrine|Sōja Shrines]] and [[Ichinomiya]]

Shinto shrines from specific sects or new churches are not included in this list.

{{Shintoism}}

This is a '''list of notable {{ill|Shinto shrine|en|Shinto shrine|WD=Q845945|lt=Shinto shrine}}s''' in {{ill|Japan|en|Japan|WD=Q17|lt=Japan}}. There are tens of thousands of shrines in {{ill|Japan|en|Japan|WD=Q17|lt=Japan}}. Shrines with structures that are {{ill|National Treasure (Japan)|en|National Treasure (Japan)|WD=Q1139795|lt=National Treasure (Japan)}} are covered by the {{ill|List of National Treasures of Japan (shrines)|en|List of National Treasures of Japan (shrines)|WD=Q3245520|lt=List of National Treasures of Japan (shrines)}}. For Shinto shrines in other countries, scroll down to the [[#See also|See also]] section.

This list includes all [[Beppyo Shrine]]s and provincial [[Sōja shrine|Sōja Shrines]] and [[Ichinomiya]]

Shinto shrines from specific sects or new churches are not included in this list.

This is a '''list of notable {{ill|Shinto shrine|en|Shinto shrine|WD=Q845945|lt=Shinto shrine}}s''' in {{ill|Japan|en|Japan|WD=Q17|lt=Japan}}. There are tens of thousands of shrines in {{ill|Japan|en|Japan|WD=Q17|lt=Japan}}. Shrines with structures that are {{ill|National Treasure (Japan)|en|National Treasure (Japan)|WD=Q1139795|lt=National Treasure (Japan)}} are covered by the {{ill|List of National Treasures of Japan (shrines)|en|List of National Treasures of Japan (shrines)|WD=Q3245520|lt=List of National Treasures of Japan (shrines)}}. For Shinto shrines in other countries, scroll down to the [[#See also|See also]] section.

This list includes all [[Beppyo Shrine]]s and provincial [[Sōja shrine|Sōja Shrines]] and [[Ichinomiya]]

Shinto shrines from specific sects or new churches are not included in this list.

{{Shintoism}}

This is a '''list of notable {{ill|Shinto shrine|en|Shinto shrine|WD=Q845945|lt=Shinto shrine}}s''' in {{ill|Japan|en|Japan|WD=Q17|lt=Japan}}. There are tens of thousands of shrines in {{ill|Japan|en|Japan|WD=Q17|lt=Japan}}. Shrines with structures that are {{ill|National Treasure (Japan)|en|National Treasure (Japan)|WD=Q1139795|lt=National Treasure (Japan)}} are covered by the {{ill|List of National Treasures of Japan (shrines)|en|List of National Treasures of Japan (shrines)|WD=Q3245520|lt=List of National Treasures of Japan (shrines)}}. For Shinto shrines in other countries, scroll down to the [[#See also|See also]] section.

This list includes all [[Beppyo Shrine]]s and provincial [[Sōja shrine|Sōja Shrines]] and [[Ichinomiya]]

Shinto shrines from specific sects or new churches are not included in this list.

{{Short description|none}}
{{Shintoism}}

This is a '''list of notable {{ill|Shinto shrine|en|Shinto shrine|WD=Q845945|lt=Shinto shrine}}s''' in {{ill|Japan|en|Japan|WD=Q17|lt=Japan}}. There are tens of thousands of shrines in {{ill|Japan|en|Japan|WD=Q17|lt=Japan}}. Shrines with structures that are {{ill|National Treasure (Japan)|en|National Treasure (Japan)|WD=Q1139795|lt=National Treasure (Japan)}} are covered by the {{ill|List of National Treasures of Japan (shrines)|en|List of National Treasures of Japan (shrines)|WD=Q3245520|lt=List of National Treasures of Japan (shrines)}}. For Shinto shrines in other countries, scroll down to the [[#See also|See also]] section.

This list includes all [[Beppyo Shrine]]s and provincial [[Sōja shrine|Sōja Shrines]] and [[Ichinomiya]]

Shinto shrines from specific sects or new churches are not included in this list.

{{Shintoism}}

This is a '''list of notable {{ill|Shinto shrine|en|Shinto shrine|WD=Q845945|lt=Shinto shrine}}s''' in {{ill|Japan|en|Japan|WD=Q17|lt=Japan}}. There are tens of thousands of shrines in {{ill|Japan|en|Japan|WD=Q17|lt=Japan}}. Shrines with structures that are {{ill|National Treasure (Japan)|en|National Treasure (Japan)|WD=Q1139795|lt=National Treasure (Japan)}} are covered by the {{ill|List of National Treasures of Japan (shrines)|en|List of National Treasures of Japan (shrines)|WD=Q3245520|lt=List of National Treasures of Japan (shrines)}}. For Shinto shrines in other countries, scroll down to the [[#See also|See also]] section.

This list includes all [[Beppyo Shrine]]s and provincial [[Sōja shrine|Sōja Shrines]] and [[Ichinomiya]]

Shinto shrines from specific sects or new churches are not included in this list.

{{Short description|none}}
{{Shintoism}}

This is a '''list of notable {{ill|Shinto shrine|en|Shinto shrine|WD=Q845945|lt=Shinto shrine|1=Shinto shrine}}s''' in {{ill|Japan|en|Japan|WD=Q17|lt=Japan|1=Japan}}. There are tens of thousands of shrines in {{ill|Japan|en|Japan|WD=Q17|lt=Japan|1=Japan}}. Shrines with structures that are {{ill|National Treasure (Japan)|en|National Treasure (Japan)|WD=Q1139795|lt=National Treasure (Japan)|1=National Treasure (Japan)}} are covered by the {{ill|List of National Treasures of Japan (shrines)|en|List of National Treasures of Japan (shrines)|WD=Q3245520|lt=List of National Treasures of Japan (shrines)|1=List of National Treasures of Japan (shrines)}}. For Shinto shrines in other countries, scroll down to the [[#See also|See also]] section.

This list includes all [[Beppyo Shrine]]s and provincial [[Sōja shrine|Sōja Shrines]] and [[Ichinomiya]]

Shinto shrines from specific sects or new churches are not included in this list.

{{Shintoism}}

This is a '''list of notable {{ill|Shinto shrine|en|Shinto shrine|WD=Q845945|lt=Shinto shrine|1=Shinto shrine}}s''' in {{ill|Japan|en|Japan|WD=Q17|lt=Japan|1=Japan}}. There are tens of thousands of shrines in {{ill|Japan|en|Japan|WD=Q17|lt=Japan|1=Japan}}. Shrines with structures that are {{ill|National Treasure (Japan)|en|National Treasure (Japan)|WD=Q1139795|lt=National Treasure (Japan)|1=National Treasure (Japan)}} are covered by the {{ill|List of National Treasures of Japan (shrines)|en|List of National Treasures of Japan (shrines)|WD=Q3245520|lt=List of National Treasures of Japan (shrines)|1=List of National Treasures of Japan (shrines)}}. For Shinto shrines in other countries, scroll down to the [[#See also|See also]] section.

This list includes all [[Beppyo Shrine]]s and provincial [[Sōja shrine|Sōja Shrines]] and [[Ichinomiya]]

Shinto shrines from specific sects or new churches are not included in this list.

{{Shintoism}}

This is a '''list of notable {{ill|Shinto shrine|en|Shinto shrine|WD=Q845945|lt=Shinto shrine|1=Shinto shrine}}s''' in {{ill|Japan|en|Japan|WD=Q17|lt=Japan|1=Japan}}. There are tens of thousands of shrines in {{ill|Japan|en|Japan|WD=Q17|lt=Japan|1=Japan}}. Shrines with structures that are {{ill|National Treasure (Japan)|en|National Treasure (Japan)|WD=Q1139795|lt=National Treasure (Japan)|1=National Treasure (Japan)}} are covered by the {{ill|List of National Treasures of Japan (shrines)|en|List of National Treasures of Japan (shrines)|WD=Q3245520|lt=List of National Treasures of Japan (shrines)|1=List of National Treasures of Japan (shrines)}}. For Shinto shrines in other countries, scroll down to the [[#See also|See also]] section.

This list includes all [[Beppyo Shrine]]s and provincial [[Sōja shrine|Sōja Shrines]] and [[Ichinomiya]]

Shinto shrines from specific sects or new churches are not included in this list.

{{Short description|none}}
{{Shintoism}}

This is a '''list of notable {{ill|Shinto shrine|en|Shinto shrine|WD=Q845945|lt=Shinto shrine|1=Shinto shrine}}s''' in {{ill|Japan|en|Japan|WD=Q17|lt=Japan|1=Japan}}. There are tens of thousands of shrines in {{ill|Japan|en|Japan|WD=Q17|lt=Japan|1=Japan}}. Shrines with structures that are {{ill|National Treasure (Japan)|en|National Treasure (Japan)|WD=Q1139795|lt=National Treasure (Japan)|1=National Treasure (Japan)}} are covered by the {{ill|List of National Treasures of Japan (shrines)|en|List of National Treasures of Japan (shrines)|WD=Q3245520|lt=List of National Treasures of Japan (shrines)|1=List of National Treasures of Japan (shrines)}}. For Shinto shrines in other countries, scroll down to the [[#See also|See also]] section.

This list includes all [[Beppyo Shrine]]s and provincial [[Sōja shrine|Sōja Shrines]] and [[Ichinomiya]]

Shinto shrines from specific sects or new churches are not included in this list.

{{Short description|none}}
{{Shintoism}}

This is a '''list of notable {{ill|Shinto shrine|en|Shinto shrine|WD=Q845945|lt=Shinto shrine|1=Shinto shrine}}s''' in {{ill|Japan|en|Japan|WD=Q17|lt=Japan|1=Japan}}. There are tens of thousands of shrines in {{ill|Japan|en|Japan|WD=Q17|lt=Japan|1=Japan}}. Shrines with structures that are {{ill|National Treasure (Japan)|en|National Treasure (Japan)|WD=Q1139795|lt=National Treasure (Japan)|1=National Treasure (Japan)}} are covered by the {{ill|List of National Treasures of Japan (shrines)|en|List of National Treasures of Japan (shrines)|WD=Q3245520|lt=List of National Treasures of Japan (shrines)|1=List of National Treasures of Japan (shrines)}}. For Shinto shrines in other countries, scroll down to the [[#See also|See also]] section.

This list includes all [[Beppyo Shrine]]s and provincial [[Sōja shrine|Sōja Shrines]] and [[Ichinomiya]]

Shinto shrines from specific sects or new churches are not included in this list.

This is a '''list of notable {{ill|Shinto shrine|en|Shinto shrine|qid=Q845945|lt=Shinto shrine|1=Shinto shrine}}s''' in {{ill|Japan|en|Japan|qid=Q17|lt=Japan|1=Japan}}. There are tens of thousands of shrines in {{ill|Japan|en|Japan|qid=Q17|lt=Japan|1=Japan}}. Shrines with structures that are {{ill|National Treasure (Japan)|en|National Treasure (Japan)|qid=Q1139795|lt=National Treasure (Japan)|1=National Treasure (Japan)}} are covered by the {{ill|List of National Treasures of Japan (shrines)|en|List of National Treasures of Japan (shrines)|qid=Q3245520|lt=List of National Treasures of Japan (shrines)|1=List of National Treasures of Japan (shrines)}}. For Shinto shrines in other countries, scroll down to the [[#See also|See also]] section.

This list includes all [[Beppyo Shrine]]s and provincial [[Sōja shrine|Sōja Shrines]] and [[Ichinomiya]]

Shinto shrines from specific sects or new churches are not included in this list.
